data.one_liner: EspTouch and EspTouchV2 smart config provisioning implementations for IoT devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides EspTouch and EspTouchV2 SmartConfig provisioning protocols in plain Dart. It allows configuring Wi-Fi credentials on headless IoT devices over UDP without knowing the network details in advance.
use_when: You need to provision ESP8266 or ESP32 Wi-Fi devices using SmartConfig from a Dart or Flutter application.
You want to implement EspTouch or EspTouchV2 protocols without native platform wrappers.
avoid_when: You are targeting the Web platform, as browsers do not allow UDP communication.
You require automatic provisioning timeouts built into the package.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Implements both EspTouch and EspTouchV2 protocols.
weaknesses: Web platform is not supported due to lack of UDP support in browsers.
Provisioning has no built-in timeout and must be stopped manually.
Requires manual firewall configuration for port 18266 on desktop platforms and special Apple Developer multicast entitlements on iOS.
data.setup_notes: On iOS 14.6/16+, a special request for Multicast API access must be made via Apple Developer account. On desktop platforms, ensure UDP port 18266 is open in the firewall for incoming data.
